The vector $u$ is an eigenvector of a $2\times 2$ matrix $B$ corresponding to the eigenvalue $\frac{1}{2}.$ Find the vector $Bu.$
worked_solution:
The eigenvector $u=[\begin{aligned}4 \\ 4\end{aligned}]$ corresponds to the eigenvalue $\lambda =\frac{1}{2}.$ So, 

$$
\begin{aligned}Bu & =\frac{1}{2}u.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, we have the following picture:

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/linear/14056271/assets/0e38721ff6fe7b75bef46079d0c877333a0113cbc782a12f61e09b832200943a.png)
